comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks an angular gripper; PR-2019 scrapes bonded char from a griddle into its grease tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision tool seating and torque counterholding; PR-2019 requires maintaining a scraper-edge attitude, applying lateral force to break debris bonds, overlapping strokes, and controlling material flow.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate scores angle accuracy, hardware retention, cycles, drift, and release; PR-2019 scores debris mass transferred to the tray, cleanliness, scraper set-down, and penalties for off-griddle debris or gouging.
comparison.reason: Surface scraping and debris containment test forceful planar tool use rather than coupled threaded adjustment and retained mechanism calibration; the scoring rubric is complete and quantitative.
